name: Lillapad
detailed_description:
In Lillapad, you play as Lilla, a young girl cursed into a tadpole by the mysterious King Frog. But when she discovers she can shift between tadpole and frog forms by hopping onto lilypads, a magical adventure begins.

Explore a magical pond hidden in her backyard, solve puzzles using your dual forms, and search for two missing petals needed to restore the Golden Lilypad, the most powerful lilypad in the pond, and break the curse to become human again.

The magic of Lilypads

Lilypads aren’t just decoration, they let you swap between frog and tadpole anytime. Each form has its own strengths, so you’ll need to use both to make it through the pond.

As a tadpole...

Swim through the deepest parts of the pond, squeeze into hidden spots, and move lilypads into place to shape your own path. You may be small, but that has its advantages.

As a frog...

Climb over rocks, break weak walls, and swing across gaps using your tongue. You can even swallow seeds to spit them out to solve puzzles. On land, your frog skills truly shine.

Meet Ruggero

Ruggero is a mysterious Italian frog who helps you uncover your transformation abilities. He’s your guide through the pond and the key to understanding your destiny.

Missing petals

The Golden Lilypad is the only thing powerful enough to break your curse—but it’s missing two petals. You’ll need to use all your frog and tadpole tricks to find them, solve environmental puzzles, and get your human self back.
